name: NetVendor
positioning: Vendor management for property operators: credentialing, compliance monitoring, contracts, competitive bidding and work execution.
description: NetVendor manages the suppliers a property operator works with rather than the properties themselves. It collects and verifies vendor credentials, watches whether insurance and licences stay current, holds the contracts, runs competitive bidding on jobs, and tracks the work through to completion. Vendors hold their own side of the account, which is how the credential file stays current without the property team chasing it.
real_estate_use: The recurring problem it solves is a maintenance job given to a contractor whose insurance has lapsed — a risk that surfaces only after something goes wrong. Here the credential check happens before the vendor is assignable, and expiry is monitored rather than remembered. Regional operators use the sourcing side when a turn has to start in a market where they have no approved contractor yet, and the bidding side when the same recurring job is being repriced across a portfolio. It sits next to a property management system rather than replacing it: the work order still lives upstream, the question of who is allowed to do the work lives here.
features: Continuous compliance and insurance expiry monitoring
Vendor sourcing from an existing network

use_cases.job: Refuse a work assignment to any vendor whose credentials have lapsed
Put a recurring job out to competitive bid across a portfolio
